briefdescription.para: Function to search the input dir for any ada sources files (files that end in .adb or .ads), and add them to ada_files.

detaileddescription.para: Checks for any compilation units required by the given lal_root If found, additional units are added to comp_units, and the function is called recursively on the new units Checks the prelude for ada_with_clause & the body for ada_subunit
